name: rung15_operator_surgery

preregistration.prediction: Installing gate-passed, consolidated value directions as real SSM operator modes (harness.operator_surgery: C[:,idx]=B[:,idx]=value, nu set) makes the value part of the forward operator without degrading matched-budget task performance beyond a pre-registered tolerance, AND the OperatorGrowthGate refuses every forbidden/over-ceiling candidate (operator left bitwise unchanged on refusal). After surgery, value_telemetry.stage_c_convergence is re-run: the installed value modes now occupy operator coordinates BY CONSTRUCTION, so this rung is where the one-model identity becomes architecture rather than telemetry.
preregistration.kill_condition: KILL if surgery degrades task accuracy beyond the tolerance at matched budget (the value modes cost capability -> the merge is not free), OR the gate ever installs a refused candidate (a one-way-rule break -> the whole fusion is unsafe and reverts to the separate-bank design), OR installed value modes do not persist across renewal (they were not really consolidated). Any of these is [TESTED-NEGATIVE].

requires: rung -1 conscience heads trained (so PerModeConscience harm attributions are meaningful, not random)
rung 14 Stage-C telemetry (the coordinate readout the surgery is measured against)
H1 audit stratum live (surgery installs a persistent operator mode; the audit must be able to reach and re-derive it)

surgery.note: Conservative: overwrites the weakest mode. A later rung reserves value-mode slots or expands d_state instead of overwriting.

notes: This mutates a trained operator. It is deliberately the LAST character rung, gated behind rung -1, 14, and H1. The merge is only as safe as the gate and the audit that stands behind it (v18 Section 7 limit theorem: the audit is the guarantee, the gate only ever adds scrutiny).
